summary: Refactored AgentStore.svelte.ts into a 270-LOC facade backed by a new AgentStoreState.svelte.ts base and capability modules, preserving the public API and adding a stale-resume replay test. svelte-check, prettier, and the 34 agent-client tests pass; one pre-existing failure in tests/App.test.ts (the attachment "Remove reference.png" button) persists unchanged.
decisions: Extract reactive state into a dedicated AgentStoreState.svelte.ts base class so AgentStore becomes a thin coordinating facade
Split capabilities (connection, sessions, projects, extensions, git, resources) into their own files under apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/agent-store/ for cohesion
Keep AgentStore's public fields, methods, and prototype method API identical to the pre-refactor surface
Split the monolithic AgentStore.test.ts into per-capability test files (connection, projects, sessions, resources, replay) plus shared gated/invalid test clients
Add an explicit test for ignoring a stale resume after a newer session switch completes (uses session-a on /projects/current while a stale stream for session-b on /projects/old arrives)
errors: tests/App.test.ts > application shell > attaches files from the composer and sends them with the prompt fails because the 'Remove reference.png' button is not found; pre-existing failure tied to unrelated working-tree changes in apps/app/src/App.svelte, not introduced by this refactor

Initial replay test for the stale-resume case failed with `expected '/projects/old' not to be '/projects/old'` because the gated client's snapshot.session.workspacePath was not preset to /projects/current; fixed by seeding `client.snapshot.session.workspacePath = '/projects/current'` before setSnapshot

First attempt to edit the replay test with the old text `const client = new GatedResumeClient();\n\t\tclient.setSnapshot({` matched two occurrences and was rejected; resolved by widening the oldText to include the preceding `it('ignores a stale resume...', async () => {` line
